problem: Students struggle to track coursework locked inside syllabi and to coordinate with classmates.

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing syllabi into structured assignment data is a nontrivial extraction problem for a small team in 2011.

defensibility.rationale: Student planner apps were easy to copy and student engagement is hard to hold.

market_need_then: Company cited high dropout and time management problems among students; no independent data found.

branding.domain_note: Used thequad.com with a prefix, not quad.com

brand_strength.rationale: Generic campus term, shared with other unrelated Quad apps; no press found.

outcome_analysis: Quad was a YC S11 mobile app for college students that turned syllabus assignments into structured data. It is listed as inactive, but no shutdown account, funding record or coverage of this specific company was found, and unrelated apps called Quad confuse the search, so the cause of the outcome is not public.
notes: Several searches returned other products called Quad (Appsurdity group chat 2013, Quad Learning). Not linked to this company. Cause of inactivity not public. YC page lists NYC and SF locations. Founded year not stated.
